description: This file handles the generation and output of a PDF for a Sales Order in the vtiger CRM system. It loads a PDF controller, processes a sales order record, and outputs the generated PDF for download.

classes.name: Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating and managing SalesOrder PDF documents.

methods.name: loadRecord
methods.description: Loads the sales order record into the PDF controller for processing.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF, either to the browser or as a file download.
